sections.Profile:
Legends of Valhalla by American Pinball is a Norse mythology-themed pinball machine designed by Scott Gullicks of Riot Pinball. Released in 2021, the game immerses players in Viking lore, featuring 16 battle modes inspired by legendary Norse figures.

- Manufacturer: American Pinball
- Years made: 2020–2021
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Vikings, 2020s, Myth, Original Theme, Solid State
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Scott Gullicks
- Concept: Scott Gullicks
- Software: Frank Gigliotti
